claims.assertion: Mari Swa recounts that, as a child on Earth, she and her mother feared agents after persistent knocking; her mother used a disguised communicator to summon a hidden Suzy-class ship, but a young couple was only returning keys.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa
claims.qualifiers: She says she was about six or seven; the ship's estimated arrival time was 15 minutes.

review_flags: This is a first-person anecdote presented as entertainment; the apparent threat resolves as a false alarm.
coverage_gaps: The introduction also describes step-down visitors and their alleged need for solitude while blending into human society.
